warnings: Both S-01 drawings (pile and spread) draw the identical ground-beam/slab layout: B5, B4, B5, B6, B6, B2 and slabs S2, S3, S3, plus the stair slab. Recorded once here instead of twice, so the beams are not double-counted.

The two B5 lines are both marked B5 on the drawing: one on row ค (between the columns) and one on the interior line ค''' (1.90 below ค) — the interior one rests on B6 at both ends, not on columns. B4 is the short beam on line 1'''''' (2.30 from grid 1) between the two B5s.
B2 here (row ข, ground beam) carries the same mark as the upper-floor B2 on S-02; S-05 has one B2 section (2-2), which the drawing applies to both.
B6 is a stepped beam: S-05 gives two cuts, 6.1-6.1 (0.20×0.50) and 6.2-6.2 (0.20×0.40), with the top stepping down 0.10 over the 1.20 portion nearer one support — see the section file.

Stair slab: the pile drawing labels it 'S0 +0.10' clearly; in the spread drawing the same circle reads like 'S4' because the dashed outline of footing F1 runs through the second character. There is no S4 detail anywhere on S-05 (only S0-S3), so it is read as S0 in both drawings.
The open ground under the house is marked 'ใต้ถุนถมดินอัดแน่น' (compacted fill) — no slab there. The wooden stair is architectural (A-08) and not an element here.
